note: Twenty-nine measured regions over eighteen pages, all accounted: 18 figure rows, 1 printed table and 10 exclusions. Eighteen figures carry flat numbers 'Figure 1:' to 'Figure 18:' with no numbered headings in the captions themselves, and the paper's headings are numbered, so `section_path` quotes the printed headings including the one that breaks mid-word at the column edge ('6 Sensitivity Evaluation of the Model under Differ-'). Seven captions print two to a line, one per column, so each row quotes the fragment carrying its own number and keeps the printed tail in its note; the two runs on p18 and the two on p20 are read left-to-right against the figure numbers. Families: 9 `bar` (the four per-lane density panels, the danger-index panels, the stacked passing-event counts), 8 `line` (the safe-gap curve, the tempo-spatial diagram, the velocity sweeps and the intelligent-system plot), 1 `other` (the velocity triangle). The paper prints four further tables - acceleration and deceleration probabilities on p10 and the same two under the intelligent system on p23 - whose caption lines and typed cell rows are in the text layer but whose pages return no measured region; they are declared gaps. The ten appendix page bands are typed MATLAB source and are excluded. Only Figures 2, 4 and 5 are named in prose. Figure 14's legend names 29m/s, 32m/s and 38m/s against the prose's 28 and 36, and Figure 15's caption tail loses its closing parenthesis in the text layer; both are recorded as printed.
rules: Every exhibit in this paper is numbered flatly - 'Figure 1:' to 'Figure 18:' and 'Table 1:' - so the colon form of the enum fits throughout and no record needs `numbering` set to `none` [caption.numbering].

Seven of the eighteen figures print their captions two to a text line, because each pair sits side by side and each column is broken mid-word; a row therefore quotes only the fragment that carries its own figure number and carries the printed tail in its note [caption.verbatim].

The side-by-side pairs are still separate measured regions with separate frames, so each panel is a row of its own with a `left of pair` / `right of pair` layout rather than one `composite-panel` [geometry.panel_layout].

In every pair the left-hand chart takes the earlier figure number and the right-hand chart the later one, read off the crop x positions: p18 row 1 is Figure 7 left and Figure 8 right, p20 row 1 is Figure 12 left and Figure 13 right [caption.verbatim].

Figure 2 is a labelled velocity triangle with no axes, no ticks and no plotted data, so it is recorded `other` with an `other_note` naming the drawing instead of being forced into `line` [geometry.family].
Table 1 prints its caption above the grid and all eighteen figures print theirs below the artwork, the split the lane records for every paper [caption.position].

The danger-index and density charts are `bar` on the ink - grouped or stacked vertical columns - while the velocity charts on the same pages are `line` polylines, so the family is read per region and not from the caption's wording [geometry.family].
Figure 11 is the paper's only stacked column chart and the only drawing with no y-axis title at all, so its scale is recorded from the tick set alone [geometry.printed_numbers].

Figure 14's legend names speed limits 29m/s, 32m/s and 38m/s while the prose says the limit was changed to 28 and 36; the discrepancy is recorded in the note rather than resolved, because the ink is authoritative [geometry.legend].

Tables 2 and 3 (p10) and Tables 4 and 5 (p23) print caption lines and typed cell rows but return no measured region from the layout pass, so they are declared gaps and are not given an invented bbox [table.rows].

The ten appendix listing bands on p27-p34 are typed MATLAB source printed as vector text: they print no caption line and carry no figure number, so they are excluded `not-an-exhibit` rather than given an empty caption block [caption.numbering].

Only Figures 2, 4 and 5 are cited by number in the prose ('as is shown in the figure 2', and the p16 sentence naming figures 4 and 5 together); the other fifteen are introduced by deictic prose or by their captions alone, so their `mention` blocks are empty [mention.count].

tables.note: The symbol list: header 'Symbol | Meaning' over eighteen entries - V, Vm, Vl, V0, V1, G, Gs, G0, Tr, Po, Pa, Pb, f, d, D, a, ap, ad - with the symbols set in italic and their subscripts set below the baseline. Three horizontal rules - above the header, under the header and closing at the foot - with no rule between rows and no vertical rule, so `rule_style` is `booktabs` and three vector paths carry them. The caption prints above the grid. Every row is prose, not a number, so `numeric_cols` is 0. This is live vector text, not a pasted image.
